title: freerange
brief: From chenglou (React core team alumnus): a static verifier that checks ordinary TypeScript layout code at compile time, without a layout engine. ~650 stars.
details: Freerange, from chenglou (React core team alumnus), is a static verifier that shows you the range of every number in your TypeScript codebase, surfacing potential NaN, Infinity, division by zero, and out-of-bounds array indexes at compile time without running your app. It uses the official TypeScript API directly — no new language, no annotations, no library functions — and respects your tsconfig, so you can swap tsc --noEmit for the fr command. fr --audit prints every function's contracts plus refactor suggestions to make code more analysis-friendly, which the author notes is especially useful for AI agents guaranteeing UI layouts without touching a browser.
